test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

Please send me __informations with regard of__ my insurance policy that I took from your company.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'information regarding​.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The part 'informations with regard of​' is incorrect as it is grammatically incorrect.
 
• With regard to is a phrase which means in respect of . Here informations is also incorrect as it is uncountable noun so information will be used instead of informations. 
 
• **Regarding to** is not like according to or due to.
 
• Regarding and in regard to</s
